events.name: Bash
events.head: Show recent T-054 commits and current task records
events.input: $ git log --oneline -8 -- workshop-plan | cat && git show --stat a39eedb 454d83d | cat && python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py --help 2>&1 | head -40 && python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the evidence table, check script header, and note ack state
events.input: $ cat [redacted].md; sed -n 1,40p workshop-plan/ops/utm_channels_check.py; grep -n "F-6991c6cc" workshop-plan/tasks/inbox.jsonl | cut -c1-600; git status --short | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check note ack state and dry-run the cleanup for leftover test rows
events.input: $ sed -n 487p workshop-plan/tasks/inbox.jsonl | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); print({k:v for k,v in d.items() if k!='text'})"; ls -la /tmp/utm-channels.json 2>&1; python3 workshop-plan/ops/utm_channels_check.py cleanup /tmp/utm-channels.json --dry 2>&1 | tail -25

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm test rows are gone from the Tantra Tracker and see pending task-file changes
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/ops/utm_channels_check.py tracker /tmp/utm-channels.json 2>&1 | tail -8; git status --short workshop-plan/tasks app/scripts | cat; git diff --stat -- workshop-plan/tasks | cat

events.name: Bash
events.head: Set T-054 to review with a recheck note and ack the feedback
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py set T-054 status=review note="Repeat of the Orchestrator note: this was already carried out today at 17:47 (all 6 channels on /workshop and /masterclass, 18 rows correct in the Work Tracker and Tantra Tracker, referral credited to member code adi, no payment made). Rechecked now without resubmitting: the cleanup dry run finds 0 test or probe rows left in the six Work Tracker tabs, ops.db and the form log, and the Tantra Tracker holds 0 of the 18 test rows. Nothing new to build; Nelbin and Bharath can sign off from the evidence table at workshop-plan/output

events.name: Bash
events.head: Commit the task board update
events.input: $ git add -- workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json && git commit -q -m "Agent T-054: repeat Orchestrator note rechecked, 0 test rows left in Work Tracker, Tantra Tracker, ops.db; stays in review

events.text: T-054 stays in review: the Orchestrator note had already been carried out and acked at 17:47 today, and a recheck found 0 test or probe rows left in the Work Tracker, Tantra Tracker, ops.db and the form log, so nothing was resubmitted or deployed.
